test_slack_adapter_connect: test the SlackAdapter connect method registers message, app_mention, and assistant lifecycle event handlers
test_slack_connect_cleanup: test the SlackAdapter releases platform lock when authentication fails during connect
test_send_document: test the SlackAdapter send_document method uploads files via files_upload_v2 with caption and thread support
test_send_video: test the SlackAdapter send_video method uploads video files and falls back to chat_postMessage on API error
test_incoming_document_handling: test the SlackAdapter _handle_slack_message downloads, caches, and classifies incoming file attachments by type
test_format_message: test the SlackAdapter format_message converts Markdown bold, italic, links, blockquotes, and code to Slack mrkdwn
test_edit_message: test the SlackAdapter edit_message applies mrkdwn formatting before sending chat_update payloads
test_edit_message_streaming: test the SlackAdapter edit_message pipeline formats progressive streaming updates with bold, links, and code blocks
test_send_typing: test the SlackAdapter send_typing indicator calls assistant_threads_setStatus with thread context
test_message_routing: test the SlackAdapter routes DM messages directly and requires bot mention for channel messages
test_thread_reply_handling: test the SlackAdapter processes thread replies only when an active session exists in the session store
test_assistant_thread_lifecycle: test the SlackAdapter seeds session store and caches assistant thread metadata on lifecycle events
test_user_name_resolution: test the SlackAdapter _resolve_user_name resolves display names with caching and fallback to user_id
test_slash_commands: test the SlackAdapter _handle_slash_command maps compact to /compress and passes through resume, background, usage, reasoning
test_message_splitting: test the SlackAdapter send method splits long messages above 40k characters into multiple chat_postMessage calls
